content: 第一关（前）

speaker: Amiya
content: GreyThroat! What's your position?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Amiya, I am providing support to an L. G. D. team.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Amiya, I am providing support to an L. G. D. team.

speaker: Amiya
content: We're about to engage!

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Attention all elite operators: this may be our first, last, and only large-scale battle in Lungmen.
speaker: Amiya
content: Attention all elite operators: this may be our first, last, and only large-scale battle in Lungmen.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Everyone take objective one as your primary mission.
speaker: Amiya
content: Everyone take objective one as your primary mission.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  My team and I will be focusing on engaging the enemy commander.
speaker: Amiya
content: My team and I will be focusing on engaging the enemy commander.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  I want you all to remember: top priority is completing the terms of our contract, that is to work with the L. G. D. to ensure the security of Lungmen.
speaker: Amiya
content: I want you all to remember: top priority is completing the terms of our contract, that is to work with the L. G. D. to ensure the security of Lungmen.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  But Rhodes Island's mission in this battle is to reduce the friction between the Infected and uninfected people, to prevent clashes!
speaker: Amiya
content: But Rhodes Island's mission in this battle is to reduce the friction between the Infected and uninfected people, to prevent clashes!

raw: [name="Amiya"]  We are Rhodes Island! No matter what else we carry into battle!
speaker: Amiya
content: We are Rhodes Island! No matter what else we carry into battle!

raw: [name="Amiya"]  No matter when, no matter where!
speaker: Amiya
content: No matter when, no matter where!

raw: [name="Amiya"]  And of course, if at any point our operations fall outside our standards, we will put a stop to them at once!
speaker: Amiya
content: And of course, if at any point our operations fall outside our standards, we will put a stop to them at once!

raw: [name="Amiya"]  As such, we go into battle with a heavy burden of responsibility on our shoulders.
speaker: Amiya
content: As such, we go into battle with a heavy burden of responsibility on our shoulders.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  That was for my sake, huh?
speaker: Blaze
content: That was for my sake, huh?

speaker: Blaze
content: She's such a worrywart...

raw: [Decision(options="We'd better speed up, or we won't make it.", values="1")]
options: We'd better speed up, or we won't make it.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  You saw what tough customers those Infected were back there. That's a lot for one operator, or even one team to handle.
speaker: Blaze
content: You saw what tough customers those Infected were back there. That's a lot for one operator, or even one team to handle.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I really should've put that kid to bed once and for all back on the rooftop.
speaker: Blaze
content: I really should've put that kid to bed once and for all back on the rooftop.

speaker: Blaze
content: Oh, copy.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  If you don't get your butt to the ambush point, I'll take all of last year's disciplinary reports and hand them over to Dr. Kal'tsit!
speaker: Amiya
content: If you don't get your butt to the ambush point, I'll take all of last year's disciplinary reports and hand them over to Dr. Kal'tsit!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Settle down! I'll be there right on time!
speaker: Blaze
content: Settle down! I'll be there right on time!

raw: [Decision(options="Amiya! She's scratching my coat!;......;Could you put me down when you take a call?", values="1;2;3")]
options: Amiya! She's scratching my coat!;......;Could you put me down when you take a call?

speaker: Amiya
content: Blaze!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  What am I supposed to do? We have to hurry...
speaker: Blaze
content: What am I supposed to do? We have to hurry...

speaker: Blaze
content: (You'll pay for that one!)

speaker: Amiya
content: Why so quiet, Doctor?

speaker: Amiya
content: ......Blaze!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I didn't do anything! It's the Doctor who clammed up!
speaker: Blaze
content: I didn't do anything! It's the Doctor who clammed up!

speaker: Blaze
content: Tell her already!

speaker: Blaze
content: Come on, say something...!

speaker: Amiya
content: Huh...?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Sorry, Doctor. I forgot you and Blaze would definitely go at it like this...
speaker: Amiya
content: Sorry, Doctor. I forgot you and Blaze would definitely go at it like this...

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I do what I gotta do.
speaker: Blaze
content: I do what I gotta do.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Why are you so pleased with yourself?
speaker: Amiya
content: Why are you so pleased with yourself?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Anyway, all I need is your location and current operation.
speaker: Amiya
content: Anyway, all I need is your location and current operation.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  You two seem to be getting along.
speaker: Amiya
content: You two seem to be getting along.

speaker: Blaze
content: Sure are!

speaker: Amiya
content: ...Really?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  (Wait, what's happening here? What should I tell her?)
speaker: Blaze
content: (Wait, what's happening here? What should I tell her?)

raw: [Decision(options="(I don't know.);(Say nothing.);(I'm not sure.)", values="1;2;3")]
[name="Blaze"]  (This is bad! Red alert! I'm taking psychic damage! I need guidance!)
speaker: Blaze
content: (This is bad! Red alert! I'm taking psychic damage! I need guidance!)

speaker: Amiya
content: Keep at it.

speaker: Blaze
content: She hung up!

speaker: Blaze
content: Oh no. We're in trouble.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  But at least we're here. Let's take a load off.
speaker: Blaze
content: But at least we're here. Let's take a load off.

raw: [Decision(options="But this is the highest point in the district?", values="1")]
options: But this is the highest point in the district?

speaker: Blaze
content: Well... shit.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  You know what they say, the shortest distance between two points is a straight line. Let's hop down.
speaker: Blaze
content: You know what they say, the shortest distance between two points is a straight line. Let's hop down.

speaker: Blaze
content: Yep. Yawn.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Hold on... If I'm not mistaken... That's Mephisto's team over there to the east, moving to the ambush zone.
speaker: Blaze
content: Hold on... If I'm not mistaken... That's Mephisto's team over there to the east, moving to the ambush zone.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  And over there... the scaly kid?
speaker: Blaze
content: And over there... the scaly kid?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  He's taking his team to fight something. What is all that black there?
speaker: Blaze
content: He's taking his team to fight something. What is all that black there?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Is that the herd...? With those numbers?!
speaker: Blaze
content: Is that the herd...? With those numbers?!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Looks like we can't rest here, Doctor. Let's go. Time for the final battle!
speaker: Blaze
content: Looks like we can't rest here, Doctor. Let's go. Time for the final battle!

speaker: Blaze
content: Hey, Amiya. Hey!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I'm taking the Doctor into the fight!
speaker: Blaze
content: I'm taking the Doctor into the fight!

speaker: Swire
content: What are you thinking?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  We let a small Reunion group go, then we track them into the slums.
speaker: Ch'en
content: We let a small Reunion group go, then we track them into the slums.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Weren't you leaving that to the special forces?
speaker: Swire
content: Weren't you leaving that to the special forces?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  No reason we can't take the opportunity.
speaker: Ch'en
content: No reason we can't take the opportunity.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I've already looked into the situation once and one thing is clear: as long as we're there, the special forces can't act openly.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I've already looked into the situation once and one thing is clear: as long as we're there, the special forces can't act openly.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Once the fighting stops, they won't be able to do much.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Once the fighting stops, they won't be able to do much.

raw: [name="Swire"]  You're not worried about orders from the top?
speaker: Swire
content: You're not worried about orders from the top?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Who's going to stand up and take responsibility for the team?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Who's going to stand up and take responsibility for the team?

raw: [name="Swire"]  All right, so you've got it all figured out. What's going on in the slums?
speaker: Swire
content: All right, so you've got it all figured out. What's going on in the slums?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  My informants have been busy. There's a few sectors I haven't been able to contact, but we have a lot more intelligence than anyone else.
speaker: Ch'en
content: My informants have been busy. There's a few sectors I haven't been able to contact, but we have a lot more intelligence than anyone else.

raw: [name="Swire"]  This is a big gamble. But I guess we have no choice.
speaker: Swire
content: This is a big gamble. But I guess we have no choice.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  The L. G. D. is the only group that can face down the special forces.
speaker: Ch'en
content: The L. G. D. is the only group that can face down the special forces.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Amiya, do you copy?

speaker: Amiya
content: Officer Ch'en, we're in position!

speaker: Ch'en
content: ...Mmhm.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I need to apologize for the whole ordeal with Reunion scooping up the Infected. That wouldn't have happened if we'd been more thoughtful.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I need to apologize for the whole ordeal with Reunion scooping up the Infected. That wouldn't have happened if we'd been more thoughtful.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  ...It's thanks to the L. G. D.'s quick action in the slums that Lungmen is able to plan against Reunion.
speaker: Amiya
content: ...It's thanks to the L. G. D.'s quick action in the slums that Lungmen is able to plan against Reunion.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  On a strategic level, I think you're fine, Officer Ch'en. But personally...
speaker: Amiya
content: On a strategic level, I think you're fine, Officer Ch'en. But personally...

speaker: Amiya
content: Officer Ch'en, Misha is dead.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  And I can't condone your opinions of the Infected. Even you know...
speaker: Amiya
content: And I can't condone your opinions of the Infected. Even you know...

raw: [name="Amiya"]  The Lungmenites who love their city will fight for her, no matter who they are.
speaker: Amiya
content: The Lungmenites who love their city will fight for her, no matter who they are.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Wow, what an awesome little bunny.
speaker: Swire
content: Wow, what an awesome little bunny.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Did I just hear Miss Swire?
speaker: Amiya
content: Did I just hear Miss Swire?

speaker: Ch'en
content: Don't mind her.

speaker: Swire
content: Hey!

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I agree with you, Amiya. Fighting for Lungmen can unite the people... except those tied up with Reunion.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I agree with you, Amiya. Fighting for Lungmen can unite the people... except those tied up with Reunion.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  But actually living in Lungmen is another matter. Time can't solve everything.
speaker: Ch'en
content: But actually living in Lungmen is another matter. Time can't solve everything.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Of course. We have to solve everything ourselves.
speaker: Amiya
content: Of course. We have to solve everything ourselves.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Wishful thinking. The Infected and uninfected live in different worlds.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Wishful thinking. The Infected and uninfected live in different worlds.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  It's not wishful thinking, Officer Ch'en. It's thinking about Misha, and the countless other Infected who died just like her.
speaker: Amiya
content: It's not wishful thinking, Officer Ch'en. It's thinking about Misha, and the countless other Infected who died just like her.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  It was the gap between those two worlds that killed them. Are we going to let that divide define us? Are we not going to fight to bridge it?
speaker: Amiya
content: It was the gap between those two worlds that killed them. Are we going to let that divide define us? Are we not going to fight to bridge it?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  I hope you can understand, Officer Ch'en, why it is that the Infected and uninfected of Rhodes Island come together to fight for Lungmen.
speaker: Amiya
content: I hope you can understand, Officer Ch'en, why it is that the Infected and uninfected of Rhodes Island come together to fight for Lungmen.

speaker: Amiya
content: They're here, Officer Ch'en.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Prepare for battle.

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]  It's an ambush! The L. G. D. is pushing us in!
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: It's an ambush! The L. G. D. is pushing us in!

raw: [name="Faust"]  Push through to the slums. Even though we haven't heard from Crownslayer... the slums are our only way out.
speaker: Faust
content: Push through to the slums. Even though we haven't heard from Crownslayer... the slums are our only way out.

speaker: Faust
content: Take him.

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]  What are you going to do?
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: What are you going to do?

raw: [name="Faust"]  Me and a few teams have encouraged the 'herd' to gather up here.
speaker: Faust
content: Me and a few teams have encouraged the 'herd' to gather up here.

raw: [name="Faust"]  They won't attack me, so I can fight alongside them.
speaker: Faust
content: They won't attack me, so I can fight alongside them.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Fire in the hole!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Fire in the hole!

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We can't hold for long!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We can't hold for long!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Herd
content: Ugh... Guhhh!!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  It's those special Infected! Look out!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: It's those special Infected! Look out!

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]  You'll bring up the rear?
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: You'll bring up the rear?

speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: You're not coming back.

speaker: Mephisto
content: Mmm! Mmhhh!!

raw: [name="Faust"]  Let him speak. He can't do his Arts like this.
speaker: Faust
content: Let him speak. He can't do his Arts like this.

speaker: Mephisto
content: What are you doing?!

speaker: Faust
content: Mephisto...

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  What are you doing?! You can't do this! Come back! Please! Come back here!
speaker: Mephisto
content: What are you doing?! You can't do this! Come back! Please! Come back here!

raw: [name="Faust"]  You once told me you would do anything I asked you.
speaker: Faust
content: You once told me you would do anything I asked you.

speaker: Mephisto
content: Sasha!

raw: [name="Faust"]  You said you don't want to make decisions for yourself.
speaker: Faust
content: You said you don't want to make decisions for yourself.

raw: [name="Faust"]  It's just, if you have your own ideas and your own goals now... I can't blame you for your choices.
speaker: Faust
content: It's just, if you have your own ideas and your own goals now... I can't blame you for your choices.

raw: [name="Faust"]  If that's the way it is, Mephisto... Well, that's great.
speaker: Faust
content: If that's the way it is, Mephisto... Well, that's great.

speaker: Faust
content: But...

speaker: Faust
content: I'm out of options.

raw: [name="Faust"]  So let me tell you my last wish.
speaker: Faust
content: So let me tell you my last wish.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Sasha...? What are you talking about? I don't understand!
speaker: Mephisto
content: Sasha...? What are you talking about? I don't understand!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Don't let them escape! Take out their commanders!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Don't let them escape! Take out their commanders!

speaker: Faust
content: ...The Rhodes Island swallow?

speaker: Faust
content: (Mouthing 'pull the trigger.')

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Hit the deck! Watch the crossfire! We've got them surrounded!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Hit the deck! Watch the crossfire! We've got them surrounded!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Fall back, Rhodes Island crossbowman! This corridor is ours!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Fall back, Rhodes Island crossbowman! This corridor is ours!

speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: Faust! Run!

speaker: Faust
content: No.

raw: [name="Faust"]  Crossbowmen, I know FrostNova is on her way. And even though Crownslayer is missing, her people are out there in the slums somewhere.
speaker: Faust
content: Crossbowmen, I know FrostNova is on her way. And even though Crownslayer is missing, her people are out there in the slums somewhere.

raw: [name="Faust"]  When FrostNova gets here, you're under her command.
speaker: Faust
content: When FrostNova gets here, you're under her command.

raw: [name="Faust"]  I trust her. Once she arrives, you'll be okay.
speaker: Faust
content: I trust her. Once she arrives, you'll be okay.

raw: [name="Faust"]  And with my Originium Arts, you'll be invisible.
speaker: Faust
content: And with my Originium Arts, you'll be invisible.

raw: [name="Phantom Crossbowman"]  You can't, Faust! That will rupture your organs!
speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: You can't, Faust! That will rupture your organs!

raw: [name="Faust"]  Doesn't matter. There's no reason not to do it anymore.
speaker: Faust
content: Doesn't matter. There's no reason not to do it anymore.

speaker: Faust
content: Retreat. That's an order.

raw: [name="Faust"]  And take him with you. But not to Chernobog.
speaker: Faust
content: And take him with you. But not to Chernobog.

speaker: Phantom Crossbowman
content: ...Faust...

speaker: Mephisto
content: You can't do this!

raw: [name="Faust"]  I hope you survive. Even on your own.
speaker: Faust
content: I hope you survive. Even on your own.

speaker: Faust
content: Don't die.

speaker: Faust
content: ——That's my last wish.

speaker: Mephisto
content: Sasha! Sashaaaaa!!!

raw: [name="Faust"]  I don't want to hurt anyone. I don't want to get anyone hurt.
speaker: Faust
content: I don't want to hurt anyone. I don't want to get anyone hurt.

raw: [name="Faust"]  I wish we had just run away, back then.
speaker: Faust
content: I wish we had just run away, back then.

raw: [name="Faust"]  We could have... just run away.
speaker: Faust
content: We could have... just run away.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Sasha, you promised! We promised each other! We swore we would survive together!
speaker: Mephisto
content: Sasha, you promised! We promised each other! We swore we would survive together!

speaker: Faust
content: It's too late... for me...

speaker: Faust
content: ...I'm too tired.

speaker: Mephisto
content: Sashaaaaaa!!!

speaker: Faust
content: Goodbye, Eno.

raw: He nocks a bolt into his crossbow, and winds it.
content: He nocks a bolt into his crossbow, and winds it.

raw: He takes aim, for the last time.
content: He takes aim, for the last time.
